name: web-retrieval-ladder
description: Jina Lord: The Blocked-Fetch Retrieval Ladder. A cost-ordered retrieval ladder for walled web pages: WebFetch, then a real-browser User-Agent, then the keyed r.jina.ai reader with the browser engine, then s.jina.ai search, then the archive.org go-around, then the seleniumbase-stealth real-browser tier. Ships the fetching-blocked-urls skill, a ladder.py instrument with diagnosis STATUS lines, and a PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure hook that flags wall signatures.
